configuration.full_text:
# 研究初始化记录；允许历史采集及基线准备，尚不提取 Kronos 表征。
schema_version: 1
status: engineering_smoke_passed_pending_research_protocol_lock
stage: initialization
task_id: 1

confirmed_fields:
  instrument: BTC-USDT-SWAP
  history_start: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'
  history_end_exclusive: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
  market: OKX_USDT_perpetual
  timeframe: 1h
  lookback_bars: 256
  holding_horizon_bars: 4
  decision_cadence_hours: 8
  decision_phase_authority: user_delegated_to_agent
  decision_hours_utc: [4, 12, 20]
  task: fixed_momentum_participate_or_skip
  costs: research_assumption_fee_5bps_slippage_2bps_per_side_stress_2x
  freqtrade_cost_proxy_per_side: [0.0007, 0.0014]

engineering_defaults:
  # 工程默认不是用户额外确认；正式评估前应审阅并锁定。
  instrument: BTC-USDT-SWAP
  ccxt_symbol: BTC/USDT:USDT
  instrument_rationale: perpetual_equivalent_of_original_BTC_example
  momentum_lookback_bars: 24
  availability_delay_seconds: 60
  availability_delay_basis: conservative_research_assumption_not_measured
  max_abs_position: 1.0
  leverage: 1.0

market:
  exchange: okx
  instrument: BTC-USDT-SWAP
  ccxt_symbol: BTC/USDT:USDT
  instrument_type: linear_USDT_perpetual
  asset_count: 1
  base_currency: BTC
  quote_currency: USDT
  settlement_currency: USDT
  timeframe: 1h
  timezone: UTC
  history_start: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'
  history_end_exclusive: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

timing:
  input_bars: completed_only
  bar_timestamp_semantics: bar_open_time
  lookback_bars: 256
  decision_cadence_hours: 8
  decision_hours_utc: [4, 12, 20]
  decision_phase_confirmation_pending: false
  decision_phase_basis: agent_selected_under_user_authorization_to_cross_observed_funding_settlement
  decision_cadence_basis: user_confirmed_avoid_freqtrade_same_candle_reentry_conflict
  decision_timestamp: scheduled_UTC_boundary_plus_availability_delay
  availability_delay_seconds: 60
  availability_delay_is_measured: false
  earliest_entry: strict_next_bar_open_after_decision
  holding_horizon_bars: 4
  exit: entry_time_plus_4_bars
  overlap_policy: nonoverlapping_labels_and_independent_reference_trades

fixed_strategy:
  momentum_lookback_bars: 24
  direction_formula: sign(log(close_t / close_t_minus_24))
  direction_zero_policy: flat
  gate_actions: [0, 1]
  gate_meaning: [skip, participate]
  allow_direction_reversal: false
  position_formula: gate_action * fixed_momentum_direction
  max_abs_position: 1.0
  leverage: 1.0

data_contract:
  model_input_fields: [open, high, low, close, volume, amount]
  volume:
    source_field: volCcy
    normalized_unit: base_BTC
    raw_contracts_field: vol
    raw_contract_volume: preserve_separately
    conversion: use_verified_instrument_contract_specification
  amount:
    source_field: volCcyQuote
    normalized_unit: quote_USDT
    definition: actual_traded_quote_turnover
    allow_price_times_volume_proxy_for_formal_evaluation: false
    missing_actual_turnover_policy: reject_formal_evaluation
  missing_bars:
    policy: reject_windows_crossing_gaps
    zero_fill: forbidden
    backward_fill: forbidden
  funding:
    settlement_events_required: true
    signed_payments_and_receipts: true
    usage: realized_label_and_ledger_only
    future_realized_funding_in_features: forbidden
    settlement_coverage_verified: true
    settlement_coverage_basis: independently_audited_published_official_archives_and_REST
    independent_exchange_internal_schedule_proof: false
    official_archive_and_REST_structural_coverage_verified: true
    snapshot_id: 20261008T011408835523Z_7bb06df6f064
    observed_settlement_interval_hours: 8
    original_mark_join_verified: true

labels_and_costs:
  label_basis: incremental_realized_net_return_of_participation_versus_skip
  classification_target: independent_reference_trade_net_return_greater_than_zero
  zero_momentum_label_policy: no_participation_label_skip_opportunity
  include_fees: true
  include_slippage: true
  include_realized_funding: true
  fee_rate: 0.0005
  slippage_rate: 0.0002
  backtest_cost_method: user_confirmed_combined_fee_expense_proxy_not_price_slippage
  freqtrade_fee_per_side: 0.0007
  freqtrade_stress_fee_per_side: 0.0014
  funding_boundary_policy: freqtrade_includes_entry_and_exit_timestamp
  cost_pressure_multiplier: 2
  cost_basis: user_confirmed_research_assumption_not_actual_account_charges
  cost_rate_unit: fraction_of_traded_notional_per_side
  reference_trade_stake_USDT: 1000
  reference_paper_wallet_USDT: 10000000
  reference_sizing_basis: fixed_notional_for_independent_labels_not_portfolio_performance
  reference_label_availability: scheduled_exit_plus_60_seconds_conservative_assumption
  minimum_economic_increment_for_promotion: null
  unresolved_values_to_lock_at_stage: 6

backtest_engine:
  name: freqtrade
  version: '2026.9'
  repository_path: 'D:/file/freqtrade'
  repository_commit: 1f394eaebc2f46a83d26971388628707802f8602
  python: 'D:/file/freqtrade/.venv/Scripts/python.exe'
  trading_mode: futures
  margin_mode: isolated
  canonical_adapter_directory: research/freqtrade
  actual_quote_turnover_storage: immutable_snapshot_sidecar
  missing_funding_rate_fallback: forbidden
  missing_mark_price_fill: forbidden
  execution_mode: research_backtest
  live_trading_enabled: false

splits:
  method: chronological_walk_forward
  status: locked_for_first_round
  lock_basis: proposed_split_proceeded_after_user_continue
  range_semantics: '[start, end_exclusive)'
  walk_forward_dates:
    - id: WF01
      train: ['2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z']
      validation: ['2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-04-01T00:00:00Z']
      test: ['2025-04-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-07-01T00:00:00Z']
    - id: WF02
      train: ['2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-04-01T00:00:00Z']
      validation: ['2025-04-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-07-01T00:00:00Z']
      test: ['2025-07-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-10-01T00:00:00Z']
    - id: WF03
      train: ['2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-07-01T00:00:00Z']
      validation: ['2025-07-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-10-01T00:00:00Z']
      test: ['2025-10-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z']
    - id: WF04
      train: ['2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-10-01T00:00:00Z']
      validation: ['2025-10-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z']
      test: ['2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z']
  final_fit:
    id: FINAL
    train: ['2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z']
    validation: ['2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z']
  final_holdout: ['2026-04-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z']
  checkpoint_time_interpretation: earlier_folds_are_retrospective_research_training_cutoff_unproven
  fit_preprocessing_on: training_fold_only
  fit_model_on: training_fold_only
  label_crossing_boundary_policy: purge
  label_availability_crossing_boundary_policy: purge
  selection_on_locked_test: forbidden
  threshold_selection_on_locked_test: forbidden

frozen_representation:
  enabled_in_current_stage: false
  model:
    repository: NeoQuasar/Kronos-small
    revision: 901c26c1332695a2a8f243eb2f37243a37bea320
  tokenizer:
    repository: NeoQuasar/Kronos-Tokenizer-base
    revision: 0e0117387f39004a9016484a186a908917e22426
  normalization:
    context: historical_lookback_only
    std_function: numpy.std
    ddof: 0
    epsilon: 0.00001
    clip_abs: 5.0
  pooling: last_valid_hidden
  inference_in_current_stage: forbidden
  feature_extraction_in_current_stage: forbidden

first_round_head:
  type: regularized_logistic_regression
  C: [0.1, 1.0, 10.0]
  decision_threshold: 0.5
  seed_set: [17, 29, 43]
  record_all_attempts: true
  training_in_current_stage: forbidden
  training_enabled_from_stage: 7

baselines:
  status: pending_implementation
  required:
    - cash
    - buy_hold
    - fixed_momentum
    - constant_half_exposure
    - vol_target
    - ordinary_features_gate

experiments:
  - id: E00
    purpose: fixed_rule_baselines_and_ordinary_features_gate
    status: pending_run
  - id: E01
    purpose: ordinary_features_plus_frozen_Kronos_same_head
    status: pending_run
  - id: E02
    purpose: ordinary_features_plus_random_frozen_backbone_same_head
    tokenizer_policy: preserve_original_pretrained_tokenizer
    status: pending_run

evaluation_readiness:
  data_integrity_accepted: true
  data_integrity_acceptance_scope: published_official_source_coverage_and_fidelity
  data_integrity_audit: research/initialization/data_integrity_audit.json
